On 11/14/2012 12:22 PM, Yi Gong wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I am testing a sem model. However, the chi-square of the model is
> always significant. I suspect it might be due to the multivariate
> normality is not met. How should I deal with this issue in lavaan?
> many thanks

If you have nonnormality, use a robust estimator (eg estimator="MLR").

For a discussion of fit indices, see the special issue of the
Personality and Individual Differences in 2007, entirely devoted to the
topic of fit indices.

Or see David Kenny's website: http://davidakenny.net/cm/fit.htm which
contains more references.

Yves.
